## James Bond Films and Box Office Revenue

This page looks at how worldwide box-office revenue has changed across James Bond films. @fig-bond-revenue shows the revenue of James Bond films over time.

::: {#cell-fig-bond-revenue .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")

plt.xlabel("Release Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (millions USD)")
plt.title("James Bond Film Revenue Over Time")

plt.show()
```
